# shop.example.com

1 high · 1 low

# F-01 — Orders of other customers readable by id

**high** · confirmed · CVSS 7.5 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N)

## Affected

https://api.shop.example.com/orders/:id

## Summary

Any signed-in customer can read any order by changing its id.

## Reproduction

1. Sign in as customer A.
2. GET /orders/<an id of customer B>.

## Impact

Names, addresses and order contents of every customer.

## Remediation

Check that the order belongs to the signed-in customer.

---

# F-02 — Reflected XSS in search

**low** · confirmed

## Affected

https://app.example.com/search?q=

## Summary

User input is reflected without encoding.
